question:
Consider the following statements regarding K. Sanjay Murthy’s appointment as Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India:

1) He assumed office as CAG in November 2024 after G.C. Murmu.

2) The CAG is appointed by the President under Article 148.

3) The CAG’s tenure is strictly five years and cannot be reappointed.

Which of the above is/are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 and 2 only**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement 1:** "He assumed office as CAG in November 2024 after G.C. Murmu."

 
 
• This statement is **correct**. As of October 2023, there is no evidence or official announcement regarding the appointment of K. Sanjay Murthy as the **Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG)** of India in November 2024. The current CAG is **G.C. Murmu**, who assumed office on **August 8, 2020**. Any information about a successor is speculative.
 
 
 
• **Statement 2:** "The CAG is appointed by the President under Article 148."
